Ranbir Singh and another
 ....Petitioners
 Versus
State of Haryana and another
 ....Respondents.
Coram:- Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjiv Berry
Present:- Mr. Amrainder Singh, Advocate for the petitioners.
Ms. Gaganpreet Kaur, D.A.G., Haryana.

Ms. Jasneet Mehra, Advocate
 for respondent No.2.

* 
SANJIV BERRY, J. (ORAL)

This is a petition filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, for quashing of FIR No.0090 dated 15.03.2023, under Sections 406 and 420 of IPC, registered at Police Station Mullana, District Ambala (Annexure P-1) and all consequential proceedings arising there from on the basis of compromise dated 09.05.2023 (Annexure P-2) executed between the parties.

2. With the intervention of respectables and elderly people of the society, the parties have arrived at a settlement vide compromise deed dated 09.05.2023 (Annexure P-2), which is duly signed by them.
The matter was referred to the Court below for recording of statements of the parties and to report with respect to genuineness of the compromise arrived at between the parties.
Judicial Magistrate First Class, Ambala, 1 of 2

1 107185 vide report dated 02.08.2023, has apprised this Court that the compromise arrived at between the parties is genuine and without any pressure.

sentences.text: 3. Respondent No. 2 is represented by his counsel and does not oppose the compromise.

4. In view of the report of the Judicial Magistrate First Class, Ambala, and in view of the decision of the Hon'ble Supreme Court in "Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab and another", 2012(4) RCR (Criminal) 543 and "Narinder Singh and Others Vs. State of Punjab and Another", (2014) 6 SCC 466, this Court is of the opinion that no useful purpose can be served by keeping with the criminal proceedings pending, since the complainants has himself compromised the dispute with the petitioners/ accused persons.

entities.text: Gian Singh Vs. State of Punjab and another", 2012(4) RCR (Criminal) 543
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Narinder Singh and Others Vs. State of Punjab and Another", (2014) 6 SCC 466
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. In the circumstances, the present petition is allowed.
FIR No.0090 dated 15.03.2023, under Sections 406 and 420 of IPC, registered at Police Station Mullana, District Ambala (Annexure P-1)
and all consequential proceedings arising therefrom, are hereby quashed on the basis of compromise qua the present petitioners.
(SANJIV BERRY)

Yes/No ii) Whether reportable?
